info.title: SILO API v2 (deployed preview)
info.description: The v2 gateway over SILO's schema `api`: 14 resources, five shared parameters, one envelope and one error object. Generated from supabase/functions/silo-api/registry.ts by scripts/gen_openapi_v2.py; do not edit by hand. Deployed preview. The v2 gateway is live; v1 remains available.

get.description:
Deployed preview. A clean (id, date, metric, value) table across families.

long rows (id, id_type, asset_class, date, metric, value, source), 3 years back from to by default, paged with the function's p_after cursor.

This playground selects `panel` on `GET /panel`. See the [full resource reference](/api-docs/v2/reference/panel) for all variants.

parameters.name: metric
parameters.description: Comma-separated catalog metric names (close, close_adj, close_return, volume, nav, delinquency, ...). auto: each id's family default, as api.panel with no p_metrics (close_adj for shares and units, close for other tickers, settlement_rate for futures, nav for funds). Comma-separated list. Default: auto.

parameters.name: freq
parameters.description: month: the last session of each month for tickers, the filed month for funds. day: tickers and futures only (funds file monthly). Default: month.

parameters.name: family
parameters.description: auto: every family a CNPJ files under (a CNPJ filing as fi and fidc yields one row per family). One family narrows the fund rows to it; with no id it walks that family (universe mode). Default: auto.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The id is a comma-separated list of tickers, fund CNPJs, option or termo tickers and futures codes, up to the tier's id ceiling. Default: none.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First date of the window, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: the resource's default window, counted back from to.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last date of the window, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: the latest complete period, from coverage.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The page size. More rows than one page come through next_page_url, never cut silently; a call stops at the tier's rows-per-call cap with meta.tier_cap_reached. Default: the tier's page maximum (10 anonymous, 100 signed in); a larger value is coerced to it.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The opaque cursor from a previous next_page_url. It carries every other parameter: send it alone (another parameter with a different value is bad_request). Default: none: the first page.

parameters.name: min_nav
parameters.description: Hidden parameter (`?help=all` lists it). Universe mode only: keep funds whose latest NAV in the window is at least this, BRL. Default: none: no floor.

parameters.name: min_months
parameters.description: Hidden parameter (`?help=all` lists it). Universe mode only: keep funds with at least this many observations of the first metric. Default: none: no floor.

default.description: The v2 error object. A SILO refusal (over_limit) keeps its message, hint and details verbatim.

bearerAuth.description: SILO user access token for authenticated data requests.

data.description: Always a list. Rows as the endpoint returned them; null stays null.

request.description: Every parameter the resource takes, with the default applied.

id_known.description: Whether SILO holds the id; null when the call names none.

tier_cap_reached.description: True when the result is partial because of the tier cap.

next_page_url.description: Present only when more rows remain. It carries one opaque cursor.
